name: aws-pptx
title: AWS PPTX Generator
description: AWS-compliant 16:9 deck generator. Applies the official AWS Architecture Icons brand system — Squid Ink dark + pure-white light themes, Smile Orange accent, eight service-category colors, Amazon Ember + Arial typography — to the Open Design fixed deck framework. Produces twelve canonical AWS slide types (Cover, Agenda, Section Divider, Content, Architecture, Two-Column, Demo/Code, Customer Story, Comparison, Summary, Resources/CTA, Q&A). Architecture diagrams are generated through the drawio skill (preferred) or the architecture-diagram skill.

query.en: Build an AWS-styled 12-slide HTML deck following the official AWS Architecture Icons brand system. Confirm: (1) theme — light or dark Squid Ink, (2) deck subject — proposal / migration / well-architected / genai / custom, (3) session code + speaker. Render every system / architecture page through the drawio skill (preferred) or the architecture-diagram skill, and use a two-column image+text layout on every technical or business content page.
query.zh-CN: 使用此插件生成 AWS 风格的 12 页 HTML deck，遵循官方 AWS Architecture Icons 品牌规范。先确认：(1) 主题：light 或 dark Squid Ink，(2) deck 题材：proposal / migration / well-architected / genai / custom，(3) session code 与演讲者。所有架构图通过 drawio skill（优先）或 architecture-diagram skill 生成，每一页技术/业务内容默认采用 image+text 双栏布局。

exampleOutputs.title: Plugin preview — palette · typography · 12 slide types

inputs.name: theme
inputs.label: Theme mode (Dark = Squid Ink + white text, AWS standard for in-person; Light = white + black text, for web/PDF)

inputs.name: deckSubject
inputs.label: Deck subject (proposal | migration | war = Well-Architected Review | genai | custom)

inputs.name: audience
inputs.label: Primary audience (e.g. AWS Solutions Architects, customer technical evaluators, internal architecture review)

inputs.name: sessionCode
inputs.label: Session code — AWS track + 3-digit level, e.g. ARC301, BOA208

inputs.name: speakerName
inputs.label: Speaker / presenter name + title, e.g. Jane Doe, Principal Solutions Architect, AWS

inputs.name: diagramApproach
inputs.label: How to handle architecture diagrams (drawio = preferred | architecture-diagram | slot = labelled placeholder)

inputs.name: techVsBusiness
inputs.label: Tech-heavy or business-heavy deck — drives every content page to image+text two-column when 'tech' or 'business'
